column9: Technical issues during CMR receipt – Non-fetching of TEC No. from WINGS and request for token creation & edit options
column10:
Sir,
It is to bring to your kind notice that Food Storage Depot, Dunguripali is facing intermittent technical problems during CMR receipt operations in ANNA Darpan, particularly at the time of token creation.
The difficulties observed are detailed below:
1.	TEC number not fetching from WINGS portal:
During token creation for CMR receipt, the TEC number is sometimes not fetched from the WINGS portal in real time. Due to this dependency on WINGS integration, receipt process gets delayed and the concerned lot cannot be processed on the same day.
2.	Single truck booking in WINGS:
In some cases, millers book the lot in WINGS portal with only one truck option, whereas physically more than one truck is involved for the same lot. This mismatch creates difficulty in completing receipt in ANNA Darpan.
3.	Lot swapping requirement:
At times, more than two stacks are allotted to a miller and due to operational necessity, the lot number requires swapping between stacks. However, there is no provision available in ANNA Darpan for modification or swapping of lot/stack details after reference creation.
4.	Non-availability of edit option:
Presently, there is no edit option available for stack number or lot number, even in genuine operational cases. This results in stack blockage and incomplete transactions.
5.	No option for depot-level token creation:
In cases where TEC/reference is generated in WINGS but not properly reflected in ANNA Darpan, there is no provision for authorized depot-level token creation, which leads to pending receipts and operational backlog.
In view of the above operational constraints, it is requested that the following provisions may kindly be enabled in ANNA Darpan:
•	Real-time synchronization and proper fetching of TEC numbers from WINGS.
•	Provision for authorized edit option for stack number and lot number in genuine cases.
•	Facility for lot swapping between allotted stacks, where required operationally.
•	Provision for authorized token creation at depot level in case of non-fetching from WINGS.
The above issues are directly affecting smooth CMR receipt operations and causing delay in reconciliation and further transactions.
It is therefore requested that the matter may kindly be examined on priority and necessary technical enhancements may be provided at the earliest.

column9: Issue in Curative (Fumigation) Entry – Classification Field Not Editable
column10:
During inspection, a stack (2A11) was classified as “Few” under pest infestation. Subsequently, the same stack was taken up for fumigation under curative treatment.

However, while entering the fumigation details in the Curative Treatment (Fumigation) module, the field “Classification Before Fumigation” is displayed as “Clear” by default and is not editable. The system does not provide an option to modify this classification to reflect the actual inspection status (e.g., Few or Heavy).

This results in incorrect data capture, as the fumigation entry does not reflect the actual infestation classification recorded during inspection.

It is therefore requested to:

Enable the “Classification Before Fumigation” field for editing, and

Provide selectable options such as Clear / Few / Heavy, aligned with the inspection classification.

This modification is necessary to ensure accurate record maintenance and data consistency between Inspection and Curative modules.

column9: Request for Provision of Digitally Signed Release Orders and Alignment of RO Numbering Pattern in Anna Darpan
column10:
It is submitted that earlier it was informed that upon full functioning of Anna Darpan, Release Orders would be generated through the portal in digital mode.

However, while examining the “Create Release Order” module in Anna Darpan, it is observed that no option is available for digital authentication of the Release Order either through Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) or Aadhaar-based e-Sign (OTP). The present process of creating Release Orders in Anna Darpan is similar to that of DOS, wherein the document is generated without any digital signature facility. As such, this does not fulfil the objective of generation of a true digital Release Order.

In the absence of digital signing functionality, Release Orders are still required to be printed, physically signed, and scanned for further circulation and record purposes, which defeats the objective of end-to-end digitization, system-based authorization, and paperless operations envisaged under Anna Darpan.

In view of the above, it is requested that necessary provision may kindly be made in Anna Darpan for generation of Digital Release Orders with, inter alia, the following functionalities:

Facility for authentication through DSC and/or Aadhaar based e-Sign (OTP).
System-generated digitally signed Release Order in PDF format.
Unique system reference number along with complete audit trail of the signing authority.
Role-based access for creation and digital approval of Release Orders.

Further, it is submitted that the Release Order number presently being generated in Anna Darpan is in the format:

“ED15012/12-2025/FPRC-002”

whereas the corresponding Release Order number generated in DOS is in the format:

“ED/15/AAY/BOILED Rice – 3907”.

It is respectfully pointed out that the numbering pattern in DOS clearly reflects the concerned scheme and commodity, which enables easy identification, segregation, verification, reconciliation, reporting, and audit scrutiny during day-to-day operations. However, the current format being generated in Anna Darpan does not indicate the scheme, due to which scheme-wise identification of Release Orders is not possible from the RO number itself, leading to avoidable operational inconvenience and dependency on manual cross-verification.

In view of the above, it is requested that the RO numbering logic in Anna Darpan may also be aligned with DOS, incorporating scheme details (and commodity, wherever feasible) in the RO number, so as to ensure uniformity, operational clarity, and continuity with existing practices.

The matter may kindly be examined on priority and necessary system-level provisioning may be made to enable creation of fully digital and legally authenticated Release Orders along with a standardized and scheme-indicative RO numbering pattern in Anna Darpan.

Screenshot of Release Order numbering in DOS & Anna Darpan and a copy of Digital RO currently being generated by this office is enclosed for perusal and consideration please.

The present process of creating Release Orders in Anna Darpan is similar to that of DOS, wherein the document is generated without any digital signature facility. As such, this does not fulfil the objective of generation of a true digital Release Order.

In the absence of digital signing functionality, Release Orders are still required to be printed, physically signed, and scanned for further circulation and record purposes, which defeats the objective of end-to-end digitization, system-based authorization, and paperless operations envisaged under Anna Darpan.

In view of the above, it is requested that necessary provision may kindly be made in Anna Darpan for generation of Digital Release Orders with, inter alia, the following functionalities:

Facility for authentication through DSC and/or Aadhaar based e-Sign (OTP).
System-generated digitally signed Release Order in PDF format.
Unique system reference number along with complete audit trail of the signing authority.
Role-based access for creation and digital approval of Release Orders.

Further, it is submitted that the Release Order number presently being generated in Anna Darpan is in the format:

“ED15012/12-2025/FPRC-002”

whereas the corresponding Release Order number generated in DOS is in the format:

“ED/15/AAY/BOILED Rice – 3907”.

It is respectfully pointed out that the numbering pattern in DOS clearly reflects the concerned scheme and commodity, which enables easy identification, segregation, verification, reconciliation, reporting, and audit scrutiny during day-to-day operations. However, the current format being generated in Anna Darpan does not indicate the scheme, due to which scheme-wise identification of Release Orders is not possible from the RO number itself, leading to avoidable operational inconvenience and dependency on manual cross-verification.

In view of the above, it is requested that the RO numbering logic in Anna Darpan may also be aligned with DOS, incorporating scheme details (and commodity, wherever feasible) in the RO number, so as to ensure uniformity, operational clarity, and continuity with existing practices.

The matter may kindly be examined on priority and necessary system-level provisioning may be made to enable creation of fully digital and legally authenticated Release Orders along with a standardized and scheme-indicative RO numbering pattern in Anna Darpan.

column9: Options not available for Gunny save/consumption at Railhead before rake loading unloading acknowledgement.
column10:
Currently, the Anna Darpan Rail Movement module does not provide any option to record gunny save/consumption at Railhead, leading to bag count mismatch.

Operational Scenario:
During rail loading, loose/spilled grains collected at the Railhead are bagged and loaded into wagons. Hence, the total bags loaded =

Bags unloaded from trucks +

Bags prepared at Railhead from loose grains

The system captures only truck-loaded bags and does not account for additional gunnies used at Railhead, resulting in inaccurate dispatch/receipt data.

Requirement:
A dedicated sub-module / field for Gunny Save/Consumption at Railhead may be added in the Movement by Rail module to ensure accurate bag accounting and data reconciliation.

column9: Migration of data from DOS to Annadarpan portal.
column10:
Respected Sir/Madam,
This is to inform you that the data currently available in the Annadarpan portal of FSD Moradabad, which was migrated from DOS, reflects the closing balance as of 10 January 2026. After this date, no further data has been migrated from DOS to Annadarpan.

In view of the above, it is not feasible to operate Annadarpan accurately until the complete data from DOS is migrated. Therefore, we kindly request you to arrange for the migration of DOS data up to 31 January 2026 into the Annadarpan portal at the earliest.
This will enable us to work properly and smoothly on the Annadarpan system.
Thanking you.
Yours sincerely,
Manager(Depot)
FSD Moradabad

column9: Issues in Contract Module
column10:
The following issues are faced wile adding contractor in Anna Daparan Contract Module;
1. The 'Authorised Person' field actually refers to the 'Awarding Authority' of the contract, hence it may be renamed a such since may of the contractor have an 'authorised person' who takes care of the day to day operations from the side of the contractor. 
2. if the contractor is MSE, now there is no option for OBC/ General MSE contractor. Hence the option need to be added.
3.ESIC registration is not mandatory for transport contractors and FSSAI registration is not mandatory for Handling and Transport contractors, but the fields are mandatory in the portal. Hence the same needs to be changed.
4. The MSE / Udyam Certificate field is also marked as mandatory even if the MSE option is not checked. It may be made mandatory only when the check box is selected.
5. In the edit contractor window, the address can be edited but not the city, state and PIN etc. which is contradictory. Also the bank account details field also need to be made editable, with the counter checking option from accounts section.

column9: Annadarpan Portal में Token Creation एवं Reporting से संबंधित तकनीकी समस्याओं के संबंध में
column10:
महोदय,
सादर निवेदन है कि Annadarpan Portal पर wagon से truck loading के दौरान token creation एवं reporting से संबंधित कुछ गंभीर तकनीकी समस्याएं निरंतर सामने आ रही हैं, जिनके कारण दैनिक कार्य संचालन में बाधा उत्पन्न हो रही है। समस्याएं निम्नलिखित हैं:

1) Annadarpan Portal पर wagon से truck loading के दौरान double token create हो रहा है, जिससे transaction में भ्रम की स्थिति बन रही है।

2) नया token create करते समय previous token का wagon number एवं bags की संख्या स्वतः (auto) add हो जा रही है, जिससे data duplication एवं गलत entry की समस्या उत्पन्न हो रही है।
3) Portal से “Truck wise – Wagon wise” transaction report generate नहीं हो पा रही है, जिससे verification एवं reconciliation कार्य प्रभावित हो रहा है।

4) Token generate होने के बाद यह स्पष्ट रूप से दिखना चाहिए कि संबंधित truck किस wagon से load हुआ है, ताकि transparency को सुनिश्चित किया जा सके।
​
अतः आपसे निवेदन है कि उपरोक्त समस्याओं का शीघ्र संज्ञान लेते हुए आवश्यक तकनीकी सुधार/rectification कराया जाए, ताकि कार्य सुचारु रूप से संचालित हो सके और भविष्य में किसी प्रकार की त्रुटि न हो।

column9: Enabling Depot-level Modification of Variety-wise Quantity in ROs to Ensure FIFO Compliance
column10:
It is submitted that Release Orders are generally created at the level of the Divisional Office wherein, for Rice, the variety Parboiled Common and for Wheat, FAQ are selected by default while generating the Release Orders.

Subsequently, depots receive stocks of different varieties, such as Grade-A Rice and URS Wheat, against later receipts. In such cases, the concerned depot submits a request in the module for conversion of variety so as to facilitate issuance of stocks accordingly.

However, the existing system provision allows conversion of variety-wise quantity only once against the Release Order. Thereafter, depots are unable to modify the variety-wise breakup despite continuous receipt of stocks of different crop years and varieties. Since stocks received later often attain priority for issuance under FIFO principles, depots are frequently required to realign the variety-wise quantities of the Release Orders to ensure compliance with FIFO and proper stock rotation.

In the absence of a repeat modification facility, depots face operational difficulty in issuing stocks strictly on FIFO basis, particularly when multiple varieties and crop years are held simultaneously.

In view of the above, it is requested that necessary system provisioning may kindly be made in Anna Darpan to enable depots to modify / re-adjust the variety-wise quantities in Release Orders more than once, as per stock availability and FIFO requirement. This will facilitate smooth issuance operations and ensure adherence to prescribed stock rotation norms.

column9: MISMATCH IN COMMODITY LEADING TO NON DISPLAY OF STACK  IN LOADING SECTION OR DURING OTHER TRANSACTION BY OUTWARD BY RO
column10:
It is submitted that the stock data was migrated from DOS to Anna Darpan on 06.12.2025. However, it has been observed that the data so migrated has been reflected as Raw Rice, whereas the data in DOS was maintained as FRK Raw Rice.

Further, it is informed that the RO created in Anna Darpan was for the commodity FRK Raw Rice. As a result of the mismatch in commodity, the stack is not reflecting in the Loading section during operations.

It is also observed that the stack is not reflecting in other transactions, in Outward by RO mode, due to the mismatch in commodity between the migrated stock and the RO.

Hence, no transaction could be carried out in the system due to the mismatch in commodity.

In view of the above, it is requested to kindly change the commodity as FRK Raw Rice for all the migrated stocks so as to enable smooth system transactions.

This is submitted for kind consideration and necessary action.
column47: For Manager QC we have provided the option to change the stack from Rice to FRK. This will work if no transaction has performed after depot provisioning. If any transaction has performed please use other transaction to account the stack.

column9: Restriction on Simultaneous Stack Operations in Anna Darpan
column10:
It has been observed that Anna Darpan allows issue operations from only one stack at a time. The system does not permit initiation of operations from the next stack until the previously opened stack is completely killed/closed.

However, at FSD Hojai, during peak dispatch and issue periods, simultaneous operation of multiple stacks (ranging from 3 to 10 stacks) is operationally required to ensure smooth and timely movement of stocks. The existing system restriction does not support this practical requirement.

This limitation causes operational delays, congestion, and inefficiencies, and does not align with the ground-level operational realities of large depots. The restriction adversely affects dispatch efficiency and throughput and therefore requires system-level modification to enable simultaneous multi-stack operations.

column9: Persistent System Issue in Generation of Release Order (RO) in Anna Darpan.
column10:
Sir,

It is respectfully submitted that after completion of allocation entry by Regional Office, Shillong, this office attempted to generate Release Orders (ROs) through the Anna Darpan system. However, the RO generation could not be completed due to a system-level allocation issue, as detailed below:

The Regional Office has entered allocations revenue district-wise. For instance, West Tripura District has been allocated 2500.06 MT, which is to be fed by HG Arundhutinagar, FSD Nandannagar, and HG Madhabari.

Further, it is submitted that certain revenue districts, such as Khowai, are also being fed by multiple godowns, namely FSD Madhabari and FSD Nandannagar.

However, while issuing RO for FSD Nandannagar, the Anna Darpan system is restricting allocation mapping only to West Tripura District. As a result, once the allocation of West Tripura District is exhausted, the system does not permit further RO generation from FSD Nandannagar, despite availability of allocation for other revenue districts being fed by the same godown.
Consequently, no further RO could be generated from FSD Nandannagar from this end. The same issue is being faced in several other godowns feeding multiple revenue districts, resulting in serious operational difficulties in generation of Release Orders.

column10: एरियल चार्जिंग :-एरियल चार्जिंग से संबंधित केमिकल (मालाथीयान) डोज़ की सही गणना सुनिश्चित करने हेतु पोर्टल में आवश्यक संशोधन किया जाना उचित होगा। एफसीआई की एसओपी के अनुसार एरियल चार्जिंग में गोडाउन का सम्पूर्ण घनफल (लंबाई × चौड़ाई × ऊँचाई), जिसमें ऊपरी कोन स्पेस एवं प्लेटफॉर्म क्षेत्र भी सम्मिलित है, को आधार बनाया जाना चाहिए। अतः पोर्टल में केवल लंबाई एवं चौड़ाई के स्थान पर घन मीटर (cu.mts) के अनुसार एरियल चार्जिंग का विकल्प उपलब्ध कराया जाए, ताकि स्टैण्डर्ड डोज़ 1 लीटर प्रति 270 घन मीटर के अनुरूप केमिकल की सही मात्रा का निर्धारण किया जा सके एवं भविष्य में किसी प्रकार की विसंगति से बचा जा सके।

column9: Priority Override Approval for Different Crop Year Issue
column10: During issue transactions, when stock from a different crop year is being issued, the system currently requires truck-wise approval before capturing the out-weight. This results in repeated approvals for every truck (for example, 40 trucks require 40 separate approvals), which slows down operations. The priority override approval may be taken once at the beginning of the stack issue transaction. Once approval is granted for issuing from a different crop year for that stack: It should remain valid for all trucks linked to that stack issue. This reduces repetitive approvals, speeds up weighment and dispatch process and minimizes operational delay.

column9: Suggestion on creation of release orders
column10: At present, for example, under the NFSA Tide-Over Scheme, separate Release Orders are required to be generated for BRA, BRC, RRA, RRC and Wheat. While these five ROs pertain to the same depot, party, RO date, validity period and other common particulars, the system requires the user to enter the same details repeatedly for each commodity and category, resulting in avoidable duplication of work and significant time consumption. It is suggested that a provision may be introduced in the system to allow generation of all five Release Orders in a single workflow, wherein the common fields such as depot, party, RO date and validity period are entered once, and only the quantities for BRA, BRC, RRA, RRC and Wheat are entered separately. This will improve efficiency, reduce data entry errors, and facilitate faster processing of Release Orders under a particular Scheme.

column9: Request to Provide Edit/Update Option for Chemical Stock to QC Incharge in Asset Management Module.
column10:
It has been observed that the chemical stock available in the Asset Stock Details List is not tallying with the actual physical stock. To correct these discrepancies, it is requested that an option to edit/update chemical stock be provided to the QC Incharge, so that the chemical position can be reconciled accurately.
A ticket has already been raised regarding Incorrect ALP Dosage and Consumption Calculation in Curative Treatment.  While recording Curative Treatment under the Preservation module, the required quantity of ALP is being calculated incorrectly. This is mainly due to wrong provision of standard dosage of chemical, which is currently set as 9Units/Mt of food grains instead of 3Units/Mt of foodgrains. As a result:
1.	The quantity of chemical used is being calculated in grams, whereas
2.	The chemical stock is maintained in units (tablets).
Since the chemical stock is managed based on units, the consumption should also be calculated and reflected in units. Due to this mismatch, the chemical stock position is not tallying in the system.
To rectify the existing discrepancies caused by this issue and other issues affecting other chemicals (Screen Shot is attached for your reference) it is essential to provide the QC Incharge with the facility to edit/update chemical stock, enabling accurate stock maintenance.
Kindly review this request and provide a suitable solution to ensure correct stock position.

column9: Availability of Depot wise Records at Division level
column10:
Sir,
At present, from the perspective of Division, in reports only three type of stock reports are available - Depot avg offtake and stock position, district wise stock and cropyear wise stock. The first report - depot avg offtake and stock position - is only showing cumulative issue. There is no entry in stock position. Hence I recommend to please add a feature in which storage, movement, contract, sales and procurement section can access the Depotwise, commodity wise, crop year wise stock position as of O/B at any date. Such Depot wise stock position report in this way should be visible at Divisional office Level to Divisional Manager, Contract, Storage, Procurement, Sales and Movement section and at Regional office level to GM, DGM and Contract, Storage, Procurement, Sales and Movement section of Regional Office.  This will enhance real time data access at all levels which is the main benefit and purpose of digitization of the process.

column9: Request for Provision of Depot-wise, Commodity Wise, Scheme-wise, Crop Year-wise Allocation–Offtake Report in Anna Darpan
column10:
It is submitted that in IRRS, a provision exists to generate a “Depot-wise, Scheme-wise, Crop Year-wise Allocation–Offtake” report, through which offtake can be monitored for a specific period, date range, and month. This report is extremely useful for operational monitoring, reconciliation, and timely reporting.

However, no such report or equivalent functionality is presently available in Anna Darpan. Due to this limitation, it becomes difficult to analyse scheme-wise and crop year-wise lifting at depot level for a defined period, and manual compilation of data from multiple sources is required, which is time-consuming and prone to error.

In this connection, an Excel sheet generated from IRRS is enclosed for your kind reference, which reflects the exact structure and utility of the said report.

In view of the above, it is requested that a similar report may kindly be developed and incorporated in Anna Darpan with the following minimum features:

• Filters for Depot, Scheme, Crop Year and Commodity
• Selection of custom date range / month / period
• Display of allocation, offtake, and balance quantities
• Export facility to Excel/PDF for official use

Provision of this report in Anna Darpan will greatly facilitate field offices in monitoring offtake performance, preparing monthly statements, responding to audit observations, and ensuring effective scheme implementation.

The same is requested to be examined on priority and necessary provision may kindly be made in the system.

column10:

column9: Mismatch of Opening and Closing Balance in Monthly Stock Statement
column10:
Mismatch of Opening and Closing Balance in Monthly Stock Statement – Anna Darpan
FSD Hojai was selected as a pilot depot and operations were carried out simultaneously in both Anna Darpan and DOS. It has been observed that in the Monthly Stock Statement generated through Anna Darpan, the closing balance of bags of one month is not being reflected as the opening balance of the subsequent month.
 For example, the closing balance of December 2025 should become the opening balance of January 2026, and similarly, the closing balance of January 2026 should be reflected as the opening balance of February 2026. However, incorrect figures are being taken in respect of bags.
The quantity (MT) figures are correctly reflected; the discrepancy is only in respect of number of bags.
QPV has been conducted in both portals and no variation in bags has been observed. The mismatch is confined only to the Monthly Stock Statement module of Anna Darpan.
This issue is serious as it affects monthly reconciliation and may lead to incorrect compilation of stock and financial data.

The Monthly Stock Statement module of Anna Darpan may be examined to ensure proper carry-forward of closing balance as opening balance for the subsequent month in respect of bags.
Necessary system-level correction may be implemented to align bag balance logic with quantity reconciliation.
 A validation control may be incorporated in the system to prevent mismatch between month-end closing balance and next month opening balance.

column9: Correction Required in Commodity Data Migrated from DOS to AnnavDarpan (24/01/2026) Migration
column10:
Description of Issue:

It is submitted that during the data migration carried out on 24/01/2026 from the Depot Online System (DOS) to AnnaDarpan, certain stocks have been incorrectly migrated.

The commodity has been migrated as “RICE RAW”, whereas the concerned stacks were originally received as “RICE RAW FRK.”

This discrepancy occurred because in the DOS system both varieties were entered under the same head as “RICE RAW,” since there was no separate option available for “FRK.” Due to the absence of a distinct FRK category in DOS, the data has been incorrectly reflected in AnnaDarpan after migration.

As a result, the commodity classification of the affected stacks is incorrect in the AnnaDarpan portal.

Request:

It is therefore requested that the above issue may kindly be examined and the commodity details of the concerned stacks be corrected at the earliest to reflect the actual receipt as RICE RAW FRK.

Early resolution of the matter is requested.

column9: Non availability of Token creation for rejected CMR consignments - Reg
column10:
In the DOS system, there is a provision to create tokens for rejected consignments. After token creation, the dumped ACK is loaded onto trucks and the consignment is sent outside with Exit gatepass from the depot. However, in the Annadarpan portal, there is no provision available for creating tokens for rejected CMR consignments. Due to this limitation, no record is being maintained in Annadarpan for rejected consignments that are taken out of this depot.
Hence, a provision similar to DOS may be included in the Annadarpan portal for rejected consignments. This would be helpful in maintaining proper records and ensuring traceability of rejected consignments.

column10:

निवेदन है कि Anna Darpan Portal पर कार्य करते समय एक गंभीर तकनीकी समस्या का सामना करना पड़ रहा है। पोर्टल पर काम के दौरान अचानक ऑटोमेटिक लॉगआउट हो जाता है, जिससे उपयोगकर्ता का चल रहा कार्य बाधित हो जाता है और पूरा कार्य पुनः प्रारंभ करना पड़ता है। इससे समय की हानि होती है तथा कार्य की उत्पादकता प्रभावित होती है।
इस समस्या के समाधान हेतु निम्नलिखित सुझाव प्रस्तुत किए जाते हैं:
1.	Session Timeout अवधि बढ़ाई जाए - वर्तमान सेशन टाइमआउट बहुत कम प्रतीत होता है। इसे कम से कम 30–60 मिनट तक बढ़ाया जाए, विशेषकर डेटा एंट्री या रिपोर्टिंग मॉड्यूल में।
2.	Auto Save Feature लागू किया जाए - पोर्टल में ऑटो-सेव फीचर जोड़ा जाए ताकि लॉगआउट या नेटवर्क समस्या की स्थिति में डेटा सुरक्षित रहे।
3.	Session Expiry Warning Message - दिया जाए लॉगआउट से पहले पॉप-अप चेतावनी दी जाए ताकि उपयोगकर्ता सेशन रिन्यू कर सके।
4.	Server Stability और Load Testing किया जाए - सर्वर लोड या नेटवर्क लेटेंसी के कारण सेशन ड्रॉप हो सकता है, अतः सर्वर पर लोड टेस्टिंग और परफॉर्मेंस ऑप्टिमाइजेशन किया जाए।
5.	Client Activity Detection लागू किया जाए - यदि उपयोगकर्ता पोर्टल पर सक्रिय है (डेटा भर रहा है या क्लिक कर रहा है), तो सेशन ऑटो एक्सपायर न हो।
6.	Network Resilience Improvement - कमजोर इंटरनेट कनेक्शन की स्थिति में सेशन को बनाए रखने हेतु री-कनेक्शन मैकेनिज्म लागू किया जाए।

उपरोक्त सुधारों से पोर्टल की उपयोगिता एवं कार्य दक्षता में उल्लेखनीय वृद्धि होगी।
कृपया आवश्यक तकनीकी सुधार करने की कृपा करें।
धन्यवाद।

column9: Deficiencies in Loading Statement Report & System Performance
column10:
It has been observed that the loading statement report for incoming rakes does not display all the required data. The report reflects only wagon numbers, whereas critical details such as number of bags and quantity loaded are not visible, thereby rendering the report incomplete and inadequate for verification and record purposes.

Further, the system response during data feeding is extremely slow, with a delay of approximately 2–3 seconds per field. Due to this sluggish performance, nearly two hours were required to feed data for only 29 wagons, adversely affecting operational efficiency and timely reporting.

Additionally, the “Specification” pop-up frequently fails to appear, which obstructs submission of the loading statement and causes repeated interruptions during data entry.

These issues collectively impact the accuracy, efficiency, and reliability of rake loading documentation and require immediate rectification.

column9: Test Wagon Assignment Issue (Manmad–Ankai Split Rakes)
column10:
At Manmad premises, two depots (FSD Manmad & FSD Ankai) receive rakes jointly. Out of 42 wagons, typically 32 are placed at Manmad and 10 at Ankai.

In DOS, we create one movement of 42 wagons at Manmad, mark 10 wagons as Missing (for Ankai), and then create a separate 10-wagon movement for Ankai. DOS allows test wagon assignment proportionately (3 wagons for 32 at Manmad and 1 wagon for 10 at Ankai).

However, in ANNA DARPAN, even after marking 10 wagons as Missing, the system still considers the full 42 wagons and asks for a minimum of 4 test wagons at Manmad. Hence, the Missing Wagon option is not serving its intended purpose.

At Manmad premises, two depots (FSD Manmad & FSD Ankai) receive rakes jointly. Out of 42 wagons, typically 32 are placed at Manmad and 10 at Ankai.

In DOS, we create one movement of 42 wagons at Manmad, mark 10 wagons as Missing (for Ankai), and then create a separate 10-wagon movement for Ankai. DOS allows test wagon assignment proportionately (3 wagons for 32 at Manmad and 1 wagon for 10 at Ankai).

However, in ANNA DARPAN, even after marking 10 wagons as Missing, the system still considers the full 42 wagons and asks for a minimum of 4 test wagons at Manmad. Hence, the Missing Wagon option is not serving its intended purpose.
